title: The night bus timetable had my name on it 🚌
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 1:48 in the morning the timetable at my bus stop had my name on it.

scenes.narration: At 1:48 in the morning the timetable at my bus stop had my name on it.
I was waiting for the last bus home. The stop is a plain glass shelter with a paper timetable I have read a hundred times.
But tonight, under the usual times, a new line had been added. Neat printing. Next arrival, you, in four minutes.
I laughed and looked up the road. It was empty. No headlights, no traffic, just fog and the one streetlight buzzing.
I looked back and the line had changed. Next arrival, you, in two minutes. The numbers were counting down.
I stepped away from the shelter. The timetable changed again. Please stay where you are, it is almost here.
Then I saw it. Not a bus. A figure at the far end of the road, walking toward me, in my coat, with my bag, at my walk.
The timetable clicked one last time. Arrived. Thank you for waiting. The last bus home leaves with whoever is standing here.
So tell me. Do you stay at the stop, or walk away?
